result.brief: 揭示条件流模型将拟合中的认知不确定性转化为样本表观偶然方差，并给出理论解释与高覆盖预测集应用，可为生成式潜空间与世界模型的方差诊断提供参考。
result.reason: Analyzes conditional flow models' sample variance and epistemic-to-aleatoric conversion; flow matching theory may transfer to generative latent/world models but abstract lacks video, representation or multimodal evidence.
